The reference arose from a Yes Bank recovery dispute initiated in 2014 and later renumbered. Litigants cannot claim the wider earlier appeal route solely because proceedings pre-date the Act.
stories.why_it_matters: The ruling clarifies procedure for older high-value cases transferred into the commercial-court system. It may narrow appeal options and change litigation strategy in pending business disputes.

stories.title: Supreme Court asks CBSE to address digital marking complaints
